title: A next --peek refused for its context generation offers an advancing next instead of the peek
outcome: A next --peek refused for its context generation offers an advancing next instead of the peek
acceptance: When `next --peek` (MCP next with peek true) is refused because its context generation is not a plain token, the CLI text, CLI JSON and MCP error offer `engram work next --peek`, not the advancing `engram work next`; a refused plain next keeps `engram work next`; a test covers both on CLI and MCP

completion.summary: Invalid-generation guidance preserves peek versus advancing next on CLI text, CLI JSON and MCP; compact/verbose regression cases pass. Landed and installed after independent acceptance.
